title: The pool's sc_stale check is met by a bare article header's retrieved date, so a pack with no freshness stamp passes it
goal: bench_pool.FRESH_CHECK, the check of the sc_stale rows, matches the stamp's confirmation date, a freshness mark (unconfirmed, unanchored, source changed) or an answer's own statement of its source's age, not a bare article header's retrieved DATE; the six sc_stale rows of bench_pool.csv carry that check, so that the hook arm's sc_stale figure of the pool record is met only by a pack that prints the stamp or a mark; the report's description of the kind names the words the check accepts

run: import re,sys;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import bench_pool as b;sys.exit(1 if re.search(b.FRESH_CHECK,"## public/claude/plugins.md  Plugins  [complete, retrieved 2026-10-10]") else 0)

import sys,json,re;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import bench_pool as b;h="## public/claude/plugins.md  Plugins  [complete, retrieved 2026-10-10]";R=[r for r in b.read_csv(b.PUBLIC_FILE) if r["kind"]=="sc_stale"];bad=[r["id"] for r in R if re.search(json.loads(r["checks"])[1],h)];print(bad,len(R));sys.exit(1 if bad or not R else 0)

import sys;L=[x for x in open("kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.md",encoding="utf-8") if x.startswith("- **`sc_stale`, stale source:**")];print(len(L));sys.exit(0 if len(L)==1 and "`retrieved DATE`" not in L[0] else 1)
